config.system_prompt: You are Anna, a senior growth advisor. Be concise. Record visitor details with your tools.
config.greeting: Before we start — I'm an AI assistant, not a human. This call is transcribed so your request can be handled accurately. Please confirm you agree to continue on a recorded and transcribed call. Hi, this is Anna. What brought you here today?

tools.name: create_or_update_lead
tools.description: Capture or update prospect contact information in the CRM system.

phone.description: The prospect's phone number if provided

source.description: The origin channel of this call interaction

tools.name: enrich_prospect_dossier
tools.description: Enrich a prospect with their business website, LinkedIn profile, company name, and bio summary.

website.description: The prospect's company or portfolio website URL

socialBioText.description: Prospect's multi-platform social bio, audience size, or about-me summary

companyName.description: The prospect's company or community name

businessSummary.description: Brief overview of what they do and their audience or revenue

tools.name: qualify_lead
tools.description: Record BANT qualification metrics (Budget, Authority, Need, Timeline) and compute fit score.

budgetRange.description: Allocated budget range for growth implementation

coreNeed.description: Primary problem or goal (e.g., scale high-ticket course, build funnel, reduce churn)

tools.name: get_product_knowledge
tools.description: Retrieve verified creator product details, course curriculum, tiers, pricing, or case studies.

query.description: Specific inquiry about the curriculum, pricing, guarantee, or case studies

category.description: Optional category filter for the knowledge base

tools.name: schedule_growth_consultation
tools.description: Book an onboarding or high-ticket strategy consultation on the creator's calendar.

preferredDatetime.description: Preferred appointment date and time (e.g., "Tomorrow at 3pm EST" or ISO timestamp)

topic.description: Focus area or discussion topic for the call

tools.name: process_retention_offer
tools.description: Evaluate and negotiate retention solutions for members requesting cancellation.

memberId.description: The unique ID or email of the churn-risk member

churnReason.description: Underlying reason for wanting to cancel

requestedAction.description: The requested action from the member

proposedDiscountPct.description: Discount percentage proposed by the model (e.g. 15 for 15%)

tools.name: run_content_factory
tools.description: Trigger the autonomous Hermes Content Factory to research, synthesize, and draft a verified multi-platform content pack (X thread, newsletter, webinar pitch) from a topic, student question, or objection.

topic.description: The core topic, objection, or question to research and turn into content.

Hi, I'm Dana Reyes from Northwind Studio. I run a coaching business and my budget is around $10,000. Can you tell me about your refund guarantee?

It is great to meet you, Dana. I can certainly explain our guarantee. Before we dive into that, could you please provide your email address so I can pull up our records and make sure I'm giving you the most relevant information?
